article_attachment_styles.summary: Attachment styles describe the promises a person brings to a partner, the way they read availability, and what they do when a partner is unavailable. After reading this you can name the four styles, describe what each one looks for and fears, recognise the signals that switch your own pattern on, and say what you need in words your partner can act on.
article_attachment_styles.title: Attachment Styles in Romantic Relationships
